_comment: Maps Billtrust export values to the exact names in your QuickBooks lists. Edit the right-hand sides to match QB EXACTLY (names are case- and punctuation-sensitive).
_exception_handling: Rows whose PO_NUMBER is non-numeric (MISC RETURNS, STOLEN MATERIAL, 33920255-001, ...) have no QB PO to link. Route to review; if coded flat, use this account.
